hook: Every Telangana school gets a daily *1-minute* water lesson
hook_b: Every Telangana school gets a daily *1-minute* water lesson
tldr: The school education department told all DEOs on Nov 15 that government and private schools, including in Hyderabad's CURE area, must run daily one-minute water conservation sessions and a pledge in assemblies, amid El Niño and deficit rain.

beats.what: Schools across Telangana must run daily water-saving messages and a pledge at morning assembly.
beats.why: HMWSSB is preparing an advance summer plan and cites deficit rainfall and low reservoir levels.
beats.care: Students are asked to turn off taps, report leaks and promote rainwater harvesting at home.

event.label: Schools told to run water pledge

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI (Nov 19): the directive covers both government and private schools.

cards.q: Will daily school sessions change how families use water?
opts: Yes, kids will push it at home

facts.t: HMWSSB says only about *2%* of its treated wastewater is reused today.

viz.l: How the school water drive works
viz.verdict: Daily one-minute sessions plus a pledge
